```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import json

subject    = r.params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(r.params["export_dir"])
trials     = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_trials.csv")
metrics    = json.loads((export_dir / f"{subject}_metrics.json").read_text())
trials.head()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(readr)

theme_mous <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1, color = "#0f172a"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "#64748b", size = base_size - 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "#475569", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "#64748b"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position  = "none"
    )
}

COND_COLORS <- c("ZINNEN" = "#2563eb", "WOORDEN" = "#16a34a", "REST" = "#d97706")

subject    <- params$subject
export_dir <- params$export_dir
trials <- read_csv(
  file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_trials.csv")),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
trials$condition <- factor(trials$condition)
```

## Mixed-Effects Model: Pre-stim β ~ Condition

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
fit <- lmer(prestim_beta ~ condition + pos_in_block + (1 | block_id), data = trials)
summary(fit)
```

## Pre-stim β by Condition

```{r}
#| label: fig-prestim-beta
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of pre-stimulus β power across conditions. Violin shows density; box shows median ± IQR."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5

ggplot(trials, aes(x = condition, y = prestim_beta, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = COND_COLORS) +
  scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLORS) +
  theme_mous() +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Pre-stimulus β power by condition –", subject),
    subtitle = "Mixed-effects model controls for position-in-block and block random effects",
    x = NULL, y = "Pre-stim β power (a.u.)"
  )
```

## Trial-wise pre-stim β vs N400m

```{r}
#| label: fig-prestim-n400m
#| fig-cap: "Aim 1 panel C equivalent: trial-level coupling between pre-stim β and N400m."
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 4.8

if (all(c("prestim_beta", "n400m", "condition") %in% names(trials))) {
  keep <- is.finite(trials$prestim_beta) & is.finite(trials$n400m)
  d <- trials[keep, ]
  if (nrow(d) >= 5) {
    cor_res <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$prestim_beta, d$n400m, method = "spearman"))
    ann <- paste0("Spearman r = ", sprintf("%.3f", unname(cor_res$estimate)), ", p = ", format.pval(cor_res$p.value, digits = 3))
    ggplot(d, aes(x = prestim_beta, y = n400m, color = condition)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.8) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.2) +
      annotate("label", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5, label = ann, size = 3.4) +
      scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLORS) +
      theme_mous() +
      theme(legend.position = "right") +
      labs(title = paste("Pre-stim β and N400m -", subject), x = "Pre-stim β power (a.u.)", y = "N400m amplitude (a.u.)")
  }
}
```
